newsitem.title: USA: Southwest Airlines offers special fares.
newsitem.headline: Southwest Airlines offers special fares.

text.p: Southwest Airlines Co on Friday said it would offer one-way fares between $39 and $59 in some cities for travel within the western United States.
The 14-day advance-purchase fares are available for sale until May 20, for travel through September 4, it said.
The one-way fares are offered on all non-stop, direct, and connecting flights between cities such as Los Angeles, Phoenix, Arizona, and Reno, Nevada, it said.
Reservations must be made at least 14 days in advance, and tickets purchased within 24 hours of making a reservation, it said.
